subject.title: Add external event hooks for quota and provider state changes

question: After exact argv round-tripping is repaired, should CodexBar permanently support opt-in local command hooks as a shared app and CLI contract?
rationale: Technical review cannot decide whether CodexBar should own durable local process execution, stable automation events, and their ongoing compatibility and security obligations.

options.title: Accept the hooks contract
options.body: Land the feature after the argv repair and final security review, treating its config, event names, payload, and CLI as supported interfaces.

options.title: Narrow the initial surface
options.body: Keep a config or CLI-only hook mechanism and defer native rule editing until a lossless interaction design is ready.

options.title: Remain observability-only
options.body: Decline local command execution and direct automation users toward external polling or serve-style integration surfaces.

recommendation.title: Accept the hooks contract
recommendation.body: Land the feature after the argv repair and final security review, treating its config, event names, payload, and CLI as supported interfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, this person is the clearest available authority for accepting a permanent command-execution and automation contract.
